Hi Olga,

It was great meeting you briefly at the summit last month. Consultio and DevCraft have been running a small series of regional co-innovation roadshows (half-day) focused on practical integration patterns for inference platforms — short product demos, a customer panel, and a hands-on lab.

We think Redwood would be an excellent co-host for an EMEA leg (London, Amsterdam, Munich) — visibility for your product team, a demo slot, and a customer panel with a joint case study. Attached is a one-pager and a proposed dates sheet.

Top asks from our side:
- Confirm interest and whether you can provide a 30–40 minute technical demo + a senior exec for a 15-minute fireside chat.
- Confirm budget for venue/audio (we typically split 50/50) and whether Redwood has any marketing co-op available (paid ads/email).
- Quick alignment on speaker names and one-pager collateral we can use.

If you’re open, could we aim to lock dates in the next two weeks? I’m copying Tomasz (partner lead) to coordinate logistics.

Thanks,
Sophie Lambert
Head of Alliances, Consultio
Sophie.lambert@consultio.com
+44 20 7123 4567

High-level thoughts:
- Audience is developer/platform engineers + 1–2 customer success folks. Good fit for our Dedicated/Dashboard narrative.
- Marketing resource ask: co-op for paid ads + Redwood newsletter inclusion would help drive attendees.
- Logistics: we should decide whether to send the same speaker to all cities (lean toward one senior eng + local field rep).

1) Ben — can you estimate marketing co-op range (low/med/high) and whether we can absorb venue share for 2 of 3 events?
2) Priyom — can you confirm whether field engineering can support a 40-minute live demo + 60-minute hands-on lab at one city (we can record).

If we like this, I’ll reply to Sophie with tentative speaker names and propose a cost split.
